text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten held at Oi.
It's the grand dirt race that caps off the end of the year.

And so, Copano Rickey was set
to clash once again with Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There... Tarumae is over there...
Maybe I should go say something.
There's still time before the race anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, she's leaving!
Wait, where are you going!?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(A pier...? Right next to Oi Wharf?
Why am I in a place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'm well aware, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (…Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know you're there, Rickey.
Why don't you come on out?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You saw right through me!?
Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... No, well...
I was just kinda curious...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what you're doing in a place like this~?
...Just asking, of course."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...The port.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai is a port town too, isn't it?
Just like Oi here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, the Port of Tomakomai just can't
compare to Tokyo Bay, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's way more cargo over on this side,
and the annual handling volume is on a whole different level...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure of it. When I did an event back home,
I heard it from an important person at the Port of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I-Is that right...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even though they're both ports, their name recognition is completely different.
Oi and Tomakomai, that is. But you see...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There is a way out.
Because the two ports are connected, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
From Ohi to Tomakomai.
Yes, if I do my best...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can ship out everyone's interest.
Even just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I always think that way.
Before I race at Ohi, that is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I won't lose. I can't lose.
If I lose, I won't be able to send off anything at all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a little bit.
From here, to my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...And that's what happened.
Her spirit was incredible..."
I groaned in thought along with Wonder Acute. She's definitely going to be quite the formidable rival today as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Rickey-chan.
I don't reckon there's any need to be so scared.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "A race is a race. I really don't think there's any Umamusume who wouldn't run with all her heart~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, Rickey-chan,
and me too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. That's true.
Even if you're not doing it specifically for your hometown—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's the final, crucial race of the year. Not a single Umamusume
would ever slack off here, right?
That's right—anyone has a chance!
choice_data_list: That's it, don't let the atmosphere overwhelm you.
That's right, don't let it overwhelm you.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I felt like I was almost dragged into
the Tarumae Zone for a second, but I gotta be myself!☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, on this grand stage at year's end,
I'm gonna show them a run that's uniquely mine!
